# 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)

Level A. [Understanding 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) on w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/link-purpose-in-context.html).

Scenarios: manual.

- [`When I view the rendered "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-viewed.js) — Checks an element is visibly rendered on the page.

## Assertions

- [`Then it should be easy to understand the purpose of each link from its text and surrounding context`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Manual check to see if link text makes sense in context.

## Example

```gherkin
Background:
  Given I load the sample "http://localhost:8081/breadcrumbs/examples/default"

@2.4.4 @a @manual
Rule: 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context), Level A
  Scenario Outline: The purpose of each link is clear from the link text, or the link text and its surrounding context
    When I view the rendered "<element>"
    Then it should be easy to understand the purpose of each link from its text and surrounding context
    Examples:
      | element                       |
      | .tl-breadcrumbs li:nth-child(1) a |
      | .tl-breadcrumbs li:nth-child(2) a |
      | .tl-breadcrumbs li:nth-child(3) a |
```
